name: rs
porting_notes: Single-file port. mbsavis() (vis.h multibyte display width) stubbed as strlen() — no multibyte on AmigaOS. vis() escape processing stubbed to pass-through. getline via amiport/stdio_ext.h, reallocarray via amiport/string.h, strtonum via amiport/err.h. getopt replaced with amiport/getopt.h. ssize_t replaced with long, %zd with %ld. pledge() stubbed. Wildcard expansion via amiport_expand_argv() with atexit cleanup. Floating-point gutter proportion requires -lm.
known_limitations: No multibyte/wide character support — mbsavis() returns byte count (strlen), not display width. No vis() escape processing — non-printable characters passed through unmodified. Both limitations have no practical impact on AmigaOS which has no locale/multibyte support.
